To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
market orientation is positively associated with company performance and that marketing orientation is positively associated, but not necessarily causally, with company performance.

(1) there is a significant relationship between market‐orientation and company performance; (2) the market‐orientation construct is not the same as marketing‐orientation; (3) the marketing‐orientation construct is more prevalent in Hong Kong than the market‐orientation; (4) marketing‐orientation is positively associated with company performance; (5) market‐orientation is positively related to marketing‐orientation; and (6) market‐orientation and marketing‐orientation are both positively related to company performance.
market orientation and marketing orientation are distinct concepts that are not necessarily positively related.

the extent to which a market‐orientation is an effective way of achieving superior performance.
